contracts.normative_equation_or_contract:
`SC-CPC-CL-C-DOMAIN` is accepted as conditional mathematics for the declared
source and target graphs. Independent physical state is (C,Z_4), with signed,
symmetric, vertex-star-supported carrier Z. With outward incidence B,
L=B^TB and endpoint-overlap matrix O, the actual ordinary map is

$$
H=I+Z/2,\quad j_0=-\frac1{1024}B^T\left(\frac1{64}BHB^TC-V'(C)\right),
\quad y=(\tfrac34I+HL)^{-1}j_0,
$$
$$
J=j_0+y/4,\quad f=H^{-1}y/2,\quad S_{ij}=O_{ij}f_if_j/4,
\quad C^+=C-32BJ,\quad Z^+=e^{-1}Z+(1-e^{-1})S.
$$

The homogeneous quartic is V(C)=((C-2)^2-1)^2/4. The declared parameters are
eta_C=1/1024, duration=32, kappa_Phi_C=1/64, tau_C=1, tau_PC=32,
chi_C=zeta_C=kappa_H=1/2, kappa_M_C=0, unit measures/weights/reference Hodges
and autonomous zero context. Current reads old Z; the writer consumes the
same pre-continuity read. Fresh final reads do not add another physical write.

For C in [0,4]^V and ||Z||_F<=1/64, H has spectrum in [127/128,129/128],
the selected current block is regular, the selector cutoff 1/64 stays
separated, and ||S||_F<1/64. Thus the carrier ball is invariant while C
remains in its declared chart. No global resource-chart invariance is claimed.
This scientific binding does not silently extend existing zero-site profiles.

`SC-CPC-CL-C-FULL-TRAP` is accepted as conditional mathematics for the full
C/Z map above. Use the retained exact charge-21 center c, target incidence,
A0=B[I+(3I/4+B^TB)^-1/4]B^T and P=(A0+11^T/15)^-1. The trap is

$$
\mathbf1^TC=21,\qquad
\max(\|C-c\|_P,1024\|Z\|_F)\le 2^{-20}.
$$

It has fourteen independent resource directions and all forty-six independent
signed symmetric star carrier directions; the carrier radius is 2^-30.
The fresh full block derivative, including both H consumers and the actual
carrier writer, gives q<0.997358 and strict image margin >2.51e-9. A separate
reference-submap certificate establishes C*, whose zero reference current
implies S*=Z*=0. The full-state contraction establishes local uniqueness and
return under nonzero carrier perturbations. A C-only or Z=0-slice trap cannot
substitute for this result.

Complete qualified domains {p,private} and {satellite2,n2,n8} persist throughout
the resource projection of the trap in both chiral charts, including all
unqualified routing terminals. This is exact-equation local stability, not
global formation, arbitrary-graph stability or a represented-map certificate.

`SC-CPC-CL-C-COMPLETION` is accepted as conditional mathematics for the bound
actual source/event/target construction. Start from the exact retained source
resource prestates and declared source carriers +2^-16 I for current and
-2^-17 I for reset. Execute one actual current PC beat, including its carrier
write, then reconstruct the fresh full event read and qualified parent.
Reset is not advanced.

Literal D11 transfers actual resources with shares (1/64,31/32,1/64), zero
core and unchanged exterior. Exact incidence and transfer identities preserve
charge 21. Under `event_loss_and_zero_target_carrier_v1`, archive both source
histories, record carrier-history loss and initialize every target carrier
entry to zero. This event disposition is not native exponential release.
Subsequent ordinary beats read and write their actual evolving carriers.

Current enters the full trap at 849 and completes two positive duration-32
beats at 851, producing one stable new child and local gain one. The independent
reset comparison enters at 817 and ends at 819 with zero live gain. These are
sufficient certified witness times, not earliest mathematical completion or
hardcoded native counters. Two charts do not count two births.

The original campaigns use fixed 8192-bit Arb; the fresh trapping calculation
uses 512 bits. Retained 112-bit outward coordinates are inspection enclosures,
not evolution states or exact replay checkpoints. Saved/fresh read and
recurrence overlap establishes consistency only. Proofs use fresh certified
enclosures. Acceptance includes the repository scientific review's limits:
no independent second reviewer or independent long-campaign replay is claimed.
